title: dedicated-fleet-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Priya Desai
description: Improvements to Dedicated Fleet autoscaler: add per-priority burst controls and more accurate utilization reporting. Motivation: reduce over-provisioning during transient spikes and give SREs better visibility into billing-impacting burst usage. This PR implements a per-priority token-bucket layer, enriches telemetry emitted by the autoscaler, and surfaces a new set of dashboards and alerts. Changes include: - tokenbucket: configurable capacity and refill per priority tier - smoother backpressure: transition window to avoid oscillation - telemetry: added metrics autoscaler.burst_tokens_{allocated,consumed}, fleet.utilization_by_priority, and burst_shed_duration_ms - reporting: daily job to compute and persist per-fleet burst_utilization summaries - backcompat: default values keep current behaviour unless priority config provided Checklist: [x] design doc (ENG-2147) [x] unit & integration tests [x] e2e smoke in perf-canary [x] dashboards updated [ ] docs page update (follow-up) Notes: I kept the config surface minimal: new field fleet.autoscaler.priorities with capacity/refill/smoothing per priority. Default cap=0 for older fleets (no change). Refs: Linear ENG-2147, ENG-2201. Breaking changes: none expected. CI: see checks below.
commits: feat(autoscaler): add priority tokenbucket implementation and config parsing
perf(autoscaler): smoothing window to reduce thrash during burst recovery
docs: add dashboard JSON and alert rules (internal path)
test: unit tests for tokenbucket edge cases
review_comments: Anika Patel: Left a question about tokenbucket refill rate calculation; suggest adding a simple docstring explaining units.
Priya Desai: Reply: added docstring and a unit conversion helper to keep rates in tokens/sec. PTAL.
James Huang: Request changes: ensure metrics tags include region+fleet_id so SRE can slice by region. Also please add a high-cardinality guard.
Priya Desai: Addressed: added region and fleet tags and low-cardinality fallback. Added unit tests for tag selection.
Rafael Ortiz: Approve after minor nits addressed (commented on log level for noisy warnings).
ci_checks: e2e-perf-canary: flaky on first run, rerun passed
release_notes:
- Added per-priority token-bucket burst controls for Dedicated fleets.
- Emitted new autoscaler metrics: autoscaler.burst_tokens_allocated, autoscaler.burst_tokens_consumed, fleet.utilization_by_priority.
- Dashboards and daily reporting job for burst utilization were added.
Operators can opt-in by setting fleet.autoscaler.priorities in config.
